title: The Tide Holds Its Breath
caption: Only the water seems to know where she went.

title: Footprints Fill With Dark Water
caption: The flats remember a crossing before dawn.

title: A Lantern Under the Fog
caption: A small light moves where the causeway should be.

title: Reeds Lean Toward Her Name
caption: The marsh answers before the narrator can speak.

title: Salt Wind Through the Pilings
caption: Something knocks below the dock in patient rhythm.

title: A Path of Silver Nails
caption: The moon drives a bright trail straight across the inlet.

title: Her Shadow Arrives First
caption: A long silhouette reaches the shore without a body.

title: Half a Moon, Half a Promise
caption: The sky withholds as much as it gives.

title: Knuckles on the Windowless Wall
caption: A sound of entering comes from a place with no house.

title: The Channel Turns White
caption: Foam gathers into a line pointing inland.

title: The Light Offshore
caption: A pale signal appears beyond the flats.

title: A Bell With No Tower
caption: The note hangs over the water and refuses to fade.

title: Boards Rise From the Tide
caption: A walkway assembles itself plank by plank.

title: The Frame Learns the Moon
caption: White wood catches enough light to resemble a doorway.

title: The Door Across the Flats
caption: At last the white frame stands where no house could be.

title: She Steps Through the Bright
caption: For one breath the threshold holds both sea and room.

title: The Room Tastes of Brine
caption: What opened inland now exhales a harbor wind.

title: Netting in the Branches
caption: Something from the bay hangs in the cypress by morning tide.

title: Her Voice From the Kitchen Tile
caption: The house answers in wet echoes to a voice long gone.

title: A Glass Left on the Sill
caption: Condensation gathers as if a guest has just departed.

title: Pale Water in the Hall
caption: The moon lays a tide line where floorboards should be dry.

title: The Threshold Empties
caption: The doorway thins until it is more weather than wood.

title: Mud Keeps the Outline
caption: A rectangular mark remains after the water pulls away.

title: Crickets After the Bell
caption: Ordinary night sounds return one by one.

title: The Dock Forgets Her Weight
caption: Boards rise a little now that no one waits there.

title: Only the Oars Move
caption: An untied boat turns slowly in a circle of light.

title: Mist Over the Causeway
caption: The route across the flats closes behind itself.

title: The Window Faces East Again
caption: What was haunted becomes merely empty.

title: Low Tide Takes the Frame
caption: By moonset the doorway is only a pale shape in the reeds.

title: The Shore Keeps the Last Light
caption: By morning only the tide and the open frame remain.
